name: SYS 01.5 - Client Intake Brief Real-Time
description: Fires on HubSpot contact.creation. Checks for website intake data, fetches all intake fields, builds a structured markdown brief, and saves to E:\IntraWeb-Technologies\04_Clients\Client Briefs.

parameters.jsCode:
const p = items[0].json.properties; const get = (k) => p[k]?.value || 'N/A'; const first = get('firstname').trim(); const last = get('lastname').trim(); const name = (first + ' ' + last).trim(); const company = get('company') === 'UNKNOWN' ? 'N/A' : get('company'); const slug = (company !== 'N/A' ? company : name).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, ''); const dateStr = get('createdate') !== 'N/A' ? new Date(get('createdate')).toLocaleDateString('en-US') : 'N/A'; const goals = get('website_intake_goals'); const industry = get('website_intake_industry'); const timeline = get('website_intake_timeline'); const pages = get('website_intake_pages'); const competitors = get('website_intake_competitors'); const designNotes = get('website_intake_design_notes'); const pageCount = pages !== 'N/A' ? pages.split(',').length : 0; const goalLower = goals.toLowerCase(); let tier = 'Growth'; let tierReason = 'Mid-range page count and goals suggest Growth tier.'; if (pageCount <= 4 || goalLower.includes('simple')) { tier = 'Starter'; tierReason = 'Limited pages and straightforward goals fit the Starter tier.'; } else if (pageCount > 8 || goalLower.includes('automat') || goalLower.includes('integrat')) { tierReason = 'Multiple pages with automation or integration goals align with Growth tier.'; } const gaps = []; if (get('phone') === 'N/A') gaps.push('No phone number on file'); if (get('website') === 'N/A') gaps.push('No existing website URL provided'); if (competitors === 'N/A') gaps.push('No competitor or inspiration sites listed'); if (designNotes === 'N/A') gaps.push('No design direction notes'); if (timeline.toLowerCase().includes('flexible')) gaps.push('Timeline is flexible - confirm hard deadlines on discovery call'); if (company === 'N/A') gaps.push('Company name unknown - confirm on call'); const gapBlock = gaps.length > 0 ? gaps.map(g => '- ' + g).join('
') : '- No critical gaps identified'; const brief = '# Client Intake Brief
**Name:** ' + name + '
**Company:** ' + company + '
**Email:** ' + get('email') + '
**Phone:** ' + get('phone') + '
**Lead Status:** ' + get('hs_lead_status') + '
**Submitted:** ' + dateStr + '

---

## What They Are Building
' + name + ' is looking to build a website for ' + company + ' in the ' + industry + ' space. Their primary goals include ' + goals.toLowerCase() + '. Timeline is ' + timeline.toLowerCase() + '.

---

## Intake Details
- **Industry:** ' + industry + '
- **Goals:** ' + goals + '
- **Timeline:** ' + timeline + '
- **Pages Requested:** ' + pages + '
- **Competitors / Inspiration:** ' + competitors + '
- **Design Notes:** ' + designNotes + '

---

## Red Flags / Gaps
' + gapBlock + '

---

## Recommended IW Tier
**' + tier + '** - ' + tierReason + '
'; return [{ json: { brief, slug, name, fileName: slug + '-intake-brief.md' } }];
